note: IA-4 (idle D3, owner 2026-10-23 02:4x) and SK-7 (owner xxxxxxxx-12/-13/-14): /status says whether the plugin's own pre-idle handoff turn is on, from idle_handoff_turn and Claude Code's idle compaction in the user settings file (idleCompaction or autoCompactEnabled false: native off, the plugin's turn at 49 min; absent: native on, and a file that is not JSON: unreadable, both the 55.5-min outcome check of owner xxxxxxxx-17, O-9 'unreadable means check what happened'; off: off), and one settings line with the six 2026-10-23 keys, never the ticket pattern or a secret rule's text (REVIEW-NIGHT-2: the status SKILL already promised both lines) IDLE-COMPACT-SPEC §4.1 (lane A): with "idleCompaction": false alone (native idle off, automatic compaction on) and idle_compact auto, the line says the plugin compacts about 54 min after the last request at the minimum (CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_COMPACT_MIN_TOKENS as native reads it, 200,000 by default) and, below it, the turn at 49 min (or none with idle_handoff_turn off); idle_compact off keeps the turn's text with (idle_compact: off); autoCompactEnabled false or DISABLE_AUTO_COMPACT is automatic compaction off (the turn only); native on with idle_handoff_turn off also says no plugin compaction runs while agents run. IDLE-COMPACT-SPEC §4.1 (lane B): the line is now `idle compaction: …` (who compacts an idle session: Claude Code, the plugin or nobody, and the pre-idle handoff turn); with no idle_mode row of this session (none here) it is read from the user settings file and says so; native on or unreadable: the plugin checks at 55.5 min and compacts itself at the minimum or more (owner Q2), below it runs its turn, with a note that Claude Code's own also runs where the plugin is not enabled. AT-IC-C37 covers the lines from the mod's idle_mode row.
